                    ### Question
                    The effect of AMP-dependent protein kinase (AMPK) on lipid metabolism is:

                    ### Options
                    opa. Activate cholesterol synthesis, by phosphorylation of hydroxymethylglutaryl-CoA reductase (HMG-CoA network).
opb. Activate lipolysis in adipose tissue, through the phosphorylation of lipoprotein lipase (LPL).
opc. Inhibit beta-oxidation of fatty acids, by phosphorylation of acyl-CoA dehydrogenase.
opd. Inhibit lipogenesis by phosphorylation of acetyl-CoA carboxylase (ACC).

### Enhanced Information (For Contextual Support):
AMP-dependent protein kinase (AMPK) inhibits lipogenesis by phosphorylating acetyl-CoA carboxylase (ACC). It also activates lipolysis in adipose tissue by phosphorylating lipoprotein lipase (LPL). There is evidence that lipoprotein lipase interacts with cells in adipose tissue, supporting the activation of lipolysis by AMPK.
